Hi, Hussain,
What do you mean by "outdoor use"?
1, high IP grade, waterproof: Like IP66, IP67 or IP68
The enclosure itself is high IP rated.
2, just industrial grade products for harsh outdoor use
It might be used in outdoor IP box, a typical example is like below link
https://www.inscapedata.com/lps3000-t1-mgt.htm
As you see, it is just a standard industrial switch(IP30 or IP40
enclosure)+an high IP rated box
Please let me know.
Thank you.
